oracle.endpoint_local_exhaustive_truth: pass for natural, two-arm final, exhaustive challenger best, and every selected challenger endpoint in all 40 cases

interpretation.primary: The frozen sequential controller transferred its no-harm architecture and used only 6.91% of exhaustive challenger compute, but recovered only 20% of available aggregate live-node gain, below the preregistered 40% usefulness threshold.
interpretation.fixed_prefix_comparison: Despite failing the usefulness threshold, the sequential controller found 2 aggregate live-node gain with 978 challenger compilations while fixed64 and fixed128 found zero gain with 2600 and 5160 compilations respectively. This supports adaptive allocation over a fixed uniform prefix, but is insufficient to validate the frozen stopping thresholds.
interpretation.failure_diagnosis: Both missed beneficial cases were rejected by the initial-gap gate (gaps 30 and 38) even though after 64 challenger compilations their best gaps had contracted to 11 and 4. This is post-hoc diagnosis only; no threshold is revised or retested on this holdout.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only; no general proof-search claim.
